source: Meechie lifeline v3 GRID: one clock-true broadcast day (86400s) laid by ET wall clock under the dj.js LL_TV grid mode. Cartoon block at the top of every regular hour in keeper order; Comedy Hour 19:00-20:00 (last special cut at 20:00 sharp, keeper style); Family Time 20:00 (Johnny Test, whole); friday13 track replaces 13:00-15:00 on Fridays (Mufti Menk khutbah, then the block as one unit). News windows and adhan are never static content: fill stands where news would be. Built 2026-11-08 from the v2 lineup content. v4 (2026-11-09): Squishy Saga Episode 1 Part 2 "Bring Me The Set" (434.0s) added to the cartoon block immediately after the Episode 1 pair, in the base day and the friday13 track; fill re-solved to the exact tenth, block and boundary times unchanged.
